thread:
ashok: Quick check — vendor (MetaMetal) just told us a surprise A100 replen shipment can ship to eu-west-2 next week. Can we reserve headroom in the Dedicated pools? Need ~8 GPUs for burst/backfill for a new customer test. Anyone tracking quotas or procurement lead time?

maria: @ashok thanks — pinged procurement team, asking for PO ETA. If this is next-week we need to approve faster than usual. Who owns the Dedicated pool sizing?

kai: I maintain the pool configs. Current eu-west-2 Dedicated has ~24 GPUs free but 12 are soft-reserved by active rollouts. We can carve 8 if we lower burst to 16 for one day. Would that work for the customer test?

ashok: Yes, this is a short 48h soak test. If we can temporarily lower burst it's fine. What's the risk for other tenants?

kai: Low risk if we lane-limit the test and set autoscale cooldown to 10m. I'll add a canary policy. Plan: temporarily reduce pool burst to 16 and pin 8 GPUs to a test allocation.

maria: Procurement says vendor needs our SKUs and billing account by EOD today to ship next-week. @sophie can you approve a one-off invoice for this?

sophie: I can approve up to $Xk today. Please post the exact line items. Also confirm whether this is committed capacity or rental.

maria: Vendor quote: 8x A100-80GB short-term rental (2 weeks) + expedited freight. Quote attached in the vendor portal. It's rental, not commit.

tim: On quotas: cloud provider shows project-level GPU quota = 64 in eu-west-2. We're currently at 48 in use across Hosted + Dedicated. If we carve 8, Hosted may hit a soft limit. I can request temporary +10 quota but it's not instant.

ashok: Can we free some Hosted capacity quickly? Any sessions we can evict safely?

kai: We have a few low-priority batch jobs running overnight; I'll cancel the ones scheduled for next 24h. That frees ~6 GPUs. Combined with reducing burst, should be enough.

deploy-bot: Reservation created: rsv-20260301-eu2 (provisional). TTL: 72h. Owner: kai. :white_check_mark:

maria: Nice. @sophie I'll DM the quote and PO draft for sign-off.

sophie: Got it, reviewing now. If procurement needs an org-code use INFRA-OPS-2.

ashok: Kai — can you set the canary policy and pin the 8 GPUs to allocation test-redwood-01? Also add TTL to revert changes automatically after 72h.

kai: On it. Commands I ran:```
# reduce burst
infractl pool update --region eu-west-2 --pool dedicated-eu2 --burst 16
# pin allocation
infractl allocation create --pool dedicated-eu2 --name test-redwood-01 --gpus 8 --ttl 72h
```

kai: Also added a routing rule to prefer on-prem fallback if latency > 300ms during the test.

tim: I'll file the quota uplift request now with cloud support and mark it high priority: case# 987654321. If they approve in <48h we can convert to committed nodes, otherwise rental path is fine.

ashok: Thanks everyone — shout if anything blocks PO or quota. Will coordinate with the customer for a tentative start on Tue. :thumbsup:

maria: PO queued, waiting for @sophie approval.

sophie: Approved, PO signed. Sending to vendor now.

ashok: Vendor confirmed shipping ETA Wed night to eu-west-2 rack staging. I'll update the customer.

kai: Reverting plan scheduled at 72h from now automatically unless we extend. Leaving tracing and cost alerts on.

ashok: Perfect — closing the loop.
